lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of approximately 5-6 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle, with higher spatial frequency and smaller diameter observed in the cephalic-anterior section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary spot rows, creating a visible lattice-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the lateral surface, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical luminance gradient, running parallel from the branchial area toward the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 10-15 high-luminance circular pixel clusters scattered across the surface area of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of micro-spots on the cephalic region, anterior to the first gill slit, displaying a significantly higher spatial frequency than the posterior flank patterning.
